description: This file is a shell script library for setting up, configuring, and testing an HTTP server within a testing framework. It contains functions for initializing the server, starting and stopping it, configuring SSL, WebDAV, SVN, and other modules, as well as test utilities for verifying server behavior.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Helper function to write executable setup scripts for HTTP server configuration.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Function to prepare the HTTP server environment, including configuration files, SSL certificates, and symbolic links.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Function to start the HTTP server with the prepared configuration.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Function to stop the running HTTP server.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 protocol support in the test server.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Enables and configures the CGIPassAuth module if supported.
